ticker_news.title: Billionaire Warren Buffett Sold 74% of Berkshire's Stake in Apple and Has Piled More Than $4 Billion Into a "Magnificent" Stock That's Up Over 11,000% Since Its IPO
ticker_news.description: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway sold 74% of its Apple stake while investing over $4 billion in Alphabet, citing Apple's stagnant growth and Alphabet's strong market position in search and cloud services.
ticker_news.author: Sean Williams

QQQ.title: If You'd Invested $1,000 in the Invesco QQQ Trust ETF 5 Years Ago, Here's How Much You'd Have Today
QQQ.description: The Invesco QQQ Trust ETF has delivered a 114% total return over five years, outperforming the S&P 500's 100% return, driven by top technology companies and AI potential.
QQQ.author: Neil Patel
